subject: Timezone bridging for MAP checkpoint + evaluation window (finalizing invite)
summary: Coordinate weekly MAP checkpoint invite across PST/EST/EU participants, confirm owners for evaluation steps, and update calendar window to accommodate Brightside's audit team.
messages:
From: Sam Miller <sam@brightside.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@brightside.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed weekly MAP checkpoint + evaluation window

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today — the MAP you shared looks aligned with our timeline. We'd like to formalize a standing 45-minute checkpoint to run the evaluation plan and unblock procurement. Our team is distributed (PST for procurement, EST for engineering, CET for the audit lead). Can Redwood propose a 48-hour window and two alternating times so we can land a recurring invite?

High-level asks:
- Weekly 45-minute sync for MAP status & evaluation readout
- 1st owner: Brightside will own the procurement milestones, Redwood to own the evaluation step and test harness run
- Please attach the latest MAP and evaluation checklist we can review before the first call

Proposed initial windows:
- Tue 10:00–10:45 PST / Tue 13:00–13:45 EST
- Wed 16:00–16:45 CET / Wed 07:00–07:45 PST (less ideal for procurement)

LMK what works; we need to lock the cadence this week to keep Q1 close timeline intact.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Miller
Director, Strategic Ops — Brightside Health
[Attachment: initial_map_request.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Sam Miller <sam@brightside.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Elena Ruiz <elena@brightside.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed weekly MAP checkpoint + evaluation window

Hi Sam — thanks, and glad the MAP looked useful.

We can do a recurring 45-minute checkpoint and I've attached our latest MAP_v2.xlsx and an evaluation_checklist.pdf (see attachments). Quick suggestions before we lock the invite:
- Prefer Tuesday window for Redwood SME participation.
- To bridge PST/EST/CET we recommend alternating weeks between 10:00 PST / 13:00 EST and 15:00 CET / 06:00 PST (we avoid sub-7am where possible).
- I'll propose two time slots on the calendar for the first four weeks so we can confirm which cadence Brightside prefers.

Owners (proposed):
- Procurement milestones: Sam Miller (Brightside)
- Evaluation harness runs & data pulls: Jasmine Liu (Redwood) — I will surface run logs to the MAP doc each week
- Security evidence & SOC items: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) to coordinate any follow-ups

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx, evaluation_checklist.pdf

Next steps: I'll push tentative invites for Tue 10:00 PST and Tue 13:00 PST (to cover the EST overlap) for the first two weeks; if Brightside prefers the CET-friendly slot we can switch the later recurring slot. Can you confirm who from your audit team (name/email) should be on the invite?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[jasmine@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Sam Miller <sam@brightside.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed weekly MAP checkpoint + evaluation window

Thanks Jasmine — quick note from ops:
- If audit participation is intermittent, let's keep the meeting to 40 minutes and leave a 10-minute buffer for post-meeting follow-ups so calendar invites don't spill overtime for EU folks.
- I'll own the calendar housekeeping (recurring invite, master attendee list) and will include a short agenda in the invite: 1) MAP status (5m), 2) evaluation run/readout (25m), 3) action items & owners (10m).

Marissa (CC'd) will also add a rotating owner tag to the agenda so ownership is explicit each week.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

On a related note — Karthik, please confirm if you can take the first security evidence action item if the audit team sends their initial questionnaire before the kickoff.

> On Mon, 21 Dec 2026 at 09:18 Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > (Attached: MAP_v2.xlsx, evaluation_checklist.pdf)
> >
> > Owners (proposed):
> > - Procurement: Sam Miller (Brightside)
> > - Evaluation runs: Jasmine Liu (Redwood)
> > - Security evidence: Karthik Iyer (Redwood)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, Sam Miller <sam@brightside.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@brightside.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed weekly MAP checkpoint + evaluation window

Confirmed — I can take the first security evidence action. If Brightside sends the SOC/materials questionnaire, please direct it to security-requests@redwood.ai and I'll triage.

FYI for scheduling: I prefer the Tue 10:00 PST / 13:00 EST slot for the first three weeks so I can align internal handoffs before the weekend.

I'll wait for Marissa's invite; happy to own the evidence item and provide a status line each week.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
